# push target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:pushTarget`](gmeow-pushTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pushTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The repository or ref that a push event targets. Non-functional: a single push operation may target multiple refs in the same repository.
